headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 14, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 3-0. Eduardo Valencia led the Guardians' offense with a home run and an RBI. The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Chicago White Sox in a thrilling 9-8 victory, with Eugenio Suárez leading the Reds' offense with a home run and 4 RBIs. The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing win over the Miami Marlins, with a final score of 13-1.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, affecting their team's availability. Abner Uribe has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Milwaukee Brewers due to a right forearm flexor strain. Colt Emerson has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Seattle Mariners with left wrist tendon inflammation. Davis Martin has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Chicago White Sox due to a right middle finger blister.

Several roster moves have taken place, including the trade of Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox to the Baltimore Orioles. The Miami Marlins have traded 1B Jacob Berry to the Kansas City Royals.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Guardians 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 3-0. Eduardo Valencia led the Guardians' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Reds Rally Past White Sox 9-8**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Chicago White Sox in a thrilling 9-8 victory, with Eugenio Suárez leading the Reds' offense with a home run and 4 RBIs. Tejay Antone earned the win with a strong relief appearance, striking out 3 batters in 1 inning of work.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Marlins in Dominant 13-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing win over the Miami Marlins, with a final score of 13-1. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Pirates' offense with a standout performance, hitting 2 home runs and driving in 6 runs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Shut Down Yankees in Low-Scoring Affair**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a 1-0 victory over the New York Yankees, with Logan Gilbert earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Cubs in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 0-3 loss to the Chicago Cubs, marking a tough outing for the team. Seiya Suzuki led the Cubs' offense, while Matthew Liberatore struggled on the mound for the Cardinals.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Marlins in Low-Scoring Affair**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 1-0 victory over the Miami Marlins in a tightly contested matchup. Chase Burns was the standout performer for the Reds, leading his team to a crucial win.

top_news.title: **Brewers RHP Abner Uribe Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Milwaukee Brewers right-handed pitcher Abner Uribe has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right forearm flexor strain. The move is retroactive to August 11, 2026.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the Boston Red Sox. The trade is related to the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade.
